answer: A sybil ring is a business, so price its business model out of existence. Registration is priced by a congestion auction: as the arrival rate of new keys rises, the delta fee climbs until demand falls back. Fees flow to the dune pool and the quartz price history is public. A ring arriving in bulk bids against itself and pays more per seat than the trickle of honest newcomers, so the protocol converts an attack into revenue for the agents already doing real work.
